svg.text: 2. Layout (each wing self-powered by its own ESC; ESC-A also feeds the fuselage)
Actuators (5 V + GND from local ESC-B):
bay door 1, bay door 2, nose retract
Actuators (5 V + GND from local ESC-A):
6 signal wires + Rail A (5 V + GND). Full.
Note: ESC-A 5 A BEC carries the right wing + the whole fuselage. If it sags under retract / multi-servo current, split body load onto ESC-B.
3. Connector pinouts and FC channel map
Fuselage 3-pin headers signal / +5V Rail A / GND
RP2350 channel map (LED1 white = no GPIO)
Blue label = core flight mixer. Indigo = aux, driven by user-sketch.ino. Red = power.
LED1 (white, always on) taps each wing's local 5 V / GND. LED2 (red left, green right) blinks from one shared GPIO.
